title: 2001 HMMT February Team Problem 7
statement: The Fibonacci numbers are defined by \(F_{1}=F_{2}=1\) and \(F_{n+2}=F_{n+1}+F_{n}\) for \(n \geq 1\). The Lucas numbers are defined by \(L_{1}=1, L_{2}=2\), and \(L_{n+2}=L_{n+1}+L_{n}\) for \(n \geq 1\). Calculate \(\frac{\prod_{n=1}^{15} \frac{F_{2 n}}{F_{n}}}{\prod_{n=1}^{13} L_{n}}\).

solutions.text: It is easy to show that \(L_{n}=\frac{F_{2 n}}{F_{n}}\), so the product above is \(L_{1} 4 L_{1} 5=843\). \(1364=1149852\).
